UC-473.en: {picked} can't run in Claude's automatic mode, so Claude stays on {kept}. To use a different model, pick another one.
UC-473.note: UC-TBD-model-switch. Host notice NoticeKind::ModelSwitchRefused: the lawyer picked a model that can't run Claude Code's auto permission mode, so Clauseo switched the session back to the model it had, and to auto; {picked} and {kept} are the models' display names, isolated (notice-words.ts)

U3-err-agent.firm_hooks_off.en: Claude can't start here: your firm's Claude settings on this computer switch off a safety check Clauseo needs (disableAllHooks or allowManagedHooksOnly). Start this conversation with ChatGPT instead.
U3-err-agent.firm_hooks_off.note: agent.firm_hooks_off: the firm's managed Claude Code settings turn hooks off (disableAllHooks or allowManagedHooksOnly) and the launch rests on Clauseo's guard hook (forced ask, or Windows), so the host didn't start Claude; Claude-only; not retryable

U3-err-agent.settings_changed.en: Claude's settings changed while it was working, so Clauseo stopped it. Send your message again to restart Claude with Clauseo's own settings.
U3-err-agent.settings_changed.note: agent.settings_changed: the settings file Clauseo writes at each launch changed while Claude ran, so Clauseo stopped Claude; the next message starts it again with Clauseo's settings; Claude-only; retryable

U3-err-agent.mode_not_set.en: Clauseo couldn't put Claude in its safe working mode, so it didn't send your message. Quit and reopen Clauseo, then send it again.
U3-err-agent.mode_not_set.note: agent.mode_not_set: Claude Code did not confirm Clauseo's mode (auto; default in forced ask; acceptEdits when auto is unavailable) after the host's session/set_mode, at launch or mid-conversation, so the host sent no message and stopped the conversation; Claude-only; not retryable

U3-err-agent.firm_policy_weakens.en: Claude can't start: a setting on this computer ({setting}) turns off a protection Clauseo needs, and only an administrator can change it. Whoever looks after this computer can change or remove it; until then, you can use ChatGPT.
U3-err-agent.firm_policy_weakens.note: agent.firm_policy_weakens: a managed Claude Code setting on this computer (the firm's policy files, macOS managed preferences, the HKLM policy, or the firm's server-managed settings) outranks a value Clauseo sets and would weaken the launch, or an administrator's policy file cannot be read. {setting} is the setting's name, isolated: the step's failure_setting (turn_failed's setting), one of the host's fixed list of Claude Code keys (e.g. sandbox.enabled), never text from a policy file; with none, or one this version doesn't know, the line is U3-err-<code>.unnamed's (no setting named); a managed Claude Code setting on this computer turns off a protection Clauseo needs, and only an administrator can change it; Claude-only; not retryable

U3-err-agent.user_policy.en: Claude can't start: a setting on this computer ({setting}) turns off a protection Clauseo needs, and only an administrator can change it. Whoever looks after this computer can change or remove it; until then, you can use ChatGPT.
U3-err-agent.user_policy.note: agent.user_policy: a Claude Code policy any program run by the user can write (Windows, HKCU\Software\Policies) sets permissions, sandbox or hooks with no administrator's policy outranking it. HKCU\Software\Policies can be written only by IT or an elevated program (laptop check, 16 Nov). {setting} is the setting's name, isolated: the step's failure_setting (turn_failed's setting), one of the host's fixed list of Claude Code keys (e.g. sandbox.enabled), never text from a policy file; with none, or one this version doesn't know, the line is U3-err-<code>.unnamed's (no setting named); a managed Claude Code setting on this computer turns off a protection Clauseo needs, and only an administrator can change it; Claude-only; not retryable

U3-err-agent.firm_policy_weakens.unnamed.en: Claude can't start: a setting on this computer turns off a protection Clauseo needs, and only an administrator can change it. Whoever looks after this computer can change or remove it; until then, you can use ChatGPT.
U3-err-agent.firm_policy_weakens.unnamed.note: agent.firm_policy_weakens with no setting named: the unnamed line (POLICY_NO_SETTING) beside U3-err-agent.firm_policy_weakens, for a step whose failure_setting is missing or one this version doesn't know (unknown); the same words for agent.firm_policy_weakens and agent.user_policy; Claude-only; not retryable

U3-err-agent.user_policy.unnamed.note: agent.user_policy with no setting named: the unnamed line (POLICY_NO_SETTING) beside U3-err-agent.user_policy, for a step whose failure_setting is missing or one this version doesn't know (unknown); the same words for agent.firm_policy_weakens and agent.user_policy; Claude-only; not retryable
